highlights_headline: Upcoming 4.156.0 changes improve native callback correctness and modernize Uno integration.
highlights_body: Android texture rendering follows the display clock, Linux HarfBuzz avoids conflicting system-library calls, and WebAssembly linking no longer compiles WebGPU C++ support inside applications. Apple deployment requirements rise, and Uno consumers should review the .NET 10 baseline and raster fallback.

breaking.title: Higher Apple deployment requirements
breaking.body: Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp require macOS 11 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS and tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 minimums remain higher. Update application deployment targets to satisfy both native and managed requirements.

breaking.title: Uno views move to Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10
breaking.body: The non-Windows Uno views assembly now requires .NET 10 and Uno Platform 7. Upgrade Uno dependencies and replace obsolete per-platform runtime packages with the common implementation; Uno.Sdk supplies platform native assets. Windows targets remain facades over SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI.

breaking.title: Uno SKSwapChainPanel uses a raster fallback
breaking.body: On non-Windows Uno targets, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, returns null GRContext and paints a raster surface; its reported backend target has framebuffer zero. RaiseOnUnsupported is removed and DrawInBackground remains unsupported. Use SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is required. The WinAppSDK control remains ANGLE-backed.

breaking.title: Legacy Uno WasmShell linking is retired
breaking.body: Pre-Uno 7 WasmShell native-asset targets are removed. Move WebAssembly applications to Uno 7's .NET SDK integration instead of the former Uno.Wasm.Bootstrap emcc pipeline.

breaking.title: SKData.CreateCopy rejects oversized array lengths
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the source array. Pass a length within the array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read.

bullets.lead: Skia m156 compiler and GLES fixes
bullets.detail: Rejects overflowing Raster Pipeline slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier in SkSL compilation. Ganesh GL also stops advertising an invalid BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration in GLES; readback is unchanged.

Corrects Skia callbacks to use one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks to use four-byte hb_bool_t values, including false-return handling. This addresses Apple ARM64 interpreter callback behavior while preserving public managed bool signatures.

Automatic texture-backed frames, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follow Choreographer display callbacks instead of buffer-swap throughput. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests remain independent and pause, resize and reattachment continue to make progress.

Binds internal bundled HarfBuzz function calls locally, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from intercepting calls and mixing incompatible private objects. Applies to the common Linux recipe, including NoDependencies builds; exported entry points are unchanged.

Ships emdawnwebgpu C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a so application C sources no longer receive incompatible C++ flags. JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed content. Newer consumers need rebuilt, GPU-enabled archives; the .NET 8 built-in path remains.

bullets.lead: Unicode conversion and native string copying
bullets.detail: Corrects StringUtilities character-code decoding for single encoded units and rejects multi-unit inputs; use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. Null byte arrays now raise ArgumentNullException in GetString. FromCString also fixes a native buffer over-read.

Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream now releases its managed reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose that borrowed stream; the caller retains disposal responsibility.

bullets.lead: Fewer temporary copy and encoding allocations
bullets.detail: Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation for valid direct-copy inputs. HarfBuzzSharp AddUtf32 string calls avoid a fresh encoded byte array, and feature-string formatting avoids native allocation while preserving existing decoding behavior.

Updates ANGLE to chromium/8118 and aligns the Windows library dependency baseline with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 for MAUI 9 and 10 integration. Public APIs and the WinUI Windows 10 build 17763 minimum are unchanged.
